definitions.ADF: constant fixed lag4; R urca::ur.df tau2 and Stata dfuller. MacKinnon p approximation not independently certified
definitions.KPSS: level constant fixed lag4; R urca::ur.kpss. Tabulated p bounds explicit
definitions.Ljung_Box: lag10, ARMA df1; native R Box.test, Stata wntestq statistic with chi2(9)
definitions.ARCH_LM: raw squared innovations, intercept, lag10, ddof1. Native Stata archlm ddof0 times 169/170. Exactly zero-mean fixture so Stata residuals equal innovations. Independent R native lm regression oracle

limits: Diagnostic calibration, not ARIMA parameter/coverage certification. Normality rejection not automatic failure. Univariate forecasts do not answer the original M0 advertising-association question. No real Agent candidate score.
garch_diagnostics: R stats::Box.test on exact standardized Stata residual/variance series; native R lm squared-innovation auxiliary regression (ddof2). Lag10, residual LB df8, squared LB df10. Fixed existing tolerance 1e-7/1e-9. Estimated-GARCH diagnostic p-values remain asymptotic approximations, not coverage certificates.
garch_estimation: Existing independent Stata joint likelihood fixtures and unchanged tests/models/arma_garch/test_joint_stata_oracle.py; existing estimation tolerances are not widened. Production diagnostics are collected from the original full-sample fitted object, not from training diagnostics.
